body.heading: Where in the world is Botswana?
paragraphs: Botswana is a country in Southern Africa, which is part of Africa.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Botswana is Gaborone.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: People in Botswana speak Tswana and English.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Botswana is the Botswana pula.

body.heading: How big is Botswana?
paragraphs: Botswana covers about 582,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of South Africa.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Every year floodwater spreads across the Kalahari to make the Okavango Delta, a watery maze of islands where elephants, hippos and lions wander. Visitors glide silently in mokoro canoes.
Chobe is famous for its enormous elephant herds. On a boat ride along the Chobe River you might count hundreds of elephants coming down to drink and splash at sunset.
